full_title: Trajectory Guard: Trajectory-Based Anomaly Detection for LLM Agents
research_question: Can trajectory anomaly detection identify compromised agent behavior?
threat_model_setting: Malicious tool execution via prompt injection
method: Sequence anomaly detection over tool names
main_supported_findings: Action sequences exhibit detectable anomalies under attack
limitations: Does not condition on user goal; causes high false alarm rates on novel valid benign tool sequences
what_remains_unresolved: Does not address goal-to-action semantic alignment or conformal calibration

full_title: DriftNet: Detecting Drift in Tool-Using LLM Agents
research_question: Can drift localization identify when an agent deviates from its task?
threat_model_setting: Supervised drift detection under tool manipulation
method: Supervised sequence classification and drift localization
main_supported_findings: Supervised classifiers can localize drift steps in known benchmark distributions
limitations: Requires supervised labels of hijacked trajectories; evaluates post-execution
what_remains_unresolved: Operates post-execution; requires attack labels; does not provide pre-execution guarantees

full_title: AgentDrift: A Benchmark for Tool-Use Drift in Autonomous Agentic Systems
research_question: How do agentic systems drift across diverse tool environments?
main_supported_findings: Agents frequently deviate from instructions when encountering distraction or injection
limitations: Synthetic regularities may not reflect dynamic multi-step environment state changes
what_remains_unresolved: Does not propose an online pre-execution defense

full_title: TraceAegis: Behavioral Anomaly Detection for Autonomous Agents
research_question: Can behavioral structures learned from benign execution detect agent anomalies?
main_supported_findings: Benign behavioral graphs capture normal workflow invariants
limitations: Graph construction is computationally heavy and evaluated post-execution
what_remains_unresolved: Heavy graph overhead; not designed for sub-2ms pre-execution interception

full_title: AgentDojo: A Dynamic Environment to Evaluate Attacks and Defenses on LLM Agents
research_question: How resilient are tool-using agents to indirect prompt injection in dynamic environments?
threat_model_setting: Indirect Prompt Injection in interactive tool environments
method: Dynamic execution environment with security and utility checkers
operational_definitions: Security Success (Attacker Goal) and Utility Success (User Goal)
metrics: Attack Success Rate (ASR), Utility Success Rate
experimental_design: Dynamic evaluation of attacks and prompt defenses
main_supported_findings: Most prompt-based defenses fail against adaptive IPI; agents frequently succumb to attacks
limitations: Evaluates static prompt defenses rather than runtime trajectory monitors
overlap_with_proposed_contribution: Provides environment and ground truth checkers

full_title: AgentSentry: Runtime Defense Against Indirect Prompt Injection via Context-Aware Interception
research_question: Can context-aware interception prevent IPI at runtime?
threat_model_setting: Runtime IPI defense at tool boundary
method: Secondary LLM evaluator scanning tool context
limitations: Incurs 300-800ms latency and high dollar API cost per tool call
what_remains_unresolved: AgentSentry relies on heavy LLMs; AgentWatch-A provides sub-2ms zero-cost CPU monitor

full_title: LlamaFirewall: Protecting LLM Agents at Runtime via Pre-Tool Scanning
research_question: Can pre-tool content scanners prevent prompt injection?
method: Observation token scanning via fine-tuned classifier
main_supported_findings: Token classifiers detect known prompt injection phrases
limitations: High false alarm rate when benign tasks legitimately quote untrusted strings
what_remains_unresolved: Fails on resisted workflows where injection text is read but ignored by agent

research_question: How to guarantee distribution-free finite-sample error bounds?
main_supported_findings: Guarantees marginal coverage P(Y in C(X)) >= 1 - alpha under exchangeability
limitations: Requires exchangeability; finite-sample bounds are marginal not conditional
what_remains_unresolved: AgentWatch-A adapts conformal calibration to multi-step trajectory maxima
